object: FIELD FOLD semantics — stop asserting what the data does not establish (unrecorded ≠ SOURCE, ACTIVE ∉ verified, the fold's own receipts ≠ independent evidence) and mechanize the receipt-staleness class
before: At origin/master 33e6df37 the fold (tools/field-fold.mjs) made three claims its input does not support: (1) 49 returns with EMPTY state fields folded to ⚊ SOURCE with why 'no state recorded' — asserting not-landed from silence; (2) the verified-marker regex matched ACTIVE, flagging 26 ACTIVE-marked rows verified on a liveness marker alone (verified_flagged 97); (3) the fold's own receipt (returns/RETURN_FIELD_FOLD_2026-10-07.json, state MERGED_VERIFIED) was counted RETURN/verified inside the very map it attests. Separately, that receipt restates counts (285/111, SOURCE 49 / HOLD 94 / RETURN 135 / RESIDUE 7, verified 95) that the auto-regenerating map (workflow field-desk-refresh runs tools/field-fold.mjs --write on every returns push) has outgrown (map at 33e6df37: 289 returns / 110 raw states / SOURCE 49 / HOLD 96 / RETURN 144 / RESIDUE 0) — a staleness class that recurs by construction whenever counts are hand-typed beside a regenerating source.
delta: tools/field-fold.mjs — empty `state` now folds to ⧗ RESIDUE kind `unrecorded` (why: 'no state recorded — UNDETERMINED (absence is not evidence of not-landed)'); the 49 silent rows no longer assert ⚊ SOURCE. Fraying residue keeps kind `fraying`, so the gate threshold still measures vocabulary fraying only, while `unrecorded_count` is reported as owned data-hygiene debt — missing data stays visibly missing, never coerced.

tools/field-fold.mjs — the VERIFIED marker regex no longer matches ACTIVE (liveness ≠ verification): only CI_GREEN / MACHINE_GREEN / BROWSER_PROV / VERIFIED / \bPASS\b / SELF_VERIFY / GREEN set the flag. Bare ACTIVE still folds ⚋ RETURN (live & usable, consistent with the route fold's ACTIVE→RETURN) but with verified=false and a why that says so.

tools/field-fold.mjs — rows whose receipt declares `object_ref: tools/field-fold.mjs` are marked `self_reference: true` and excluded from `verified_flagged_independent`; the map reports both counts plus `self_reference_files`, so the fold never counts its own receipts as evidence again.

tools/field-fold.mjs — RECEIPT SYNC (the staleness mechanism): every run compares each fold receipt's restated counts against the live map and writes the verdict + per-field mismatches into map.receipt_sync; a receipt that restates counts must declare `counts_as_of`, and `node tools/field-fold.mjs --check-receipts` exits non-zero when one does not (proven firing on this exact defect before the annotation below landed). The drift class is now flagged BY THE REGENERATION ITSELF on every lap instead of aging silently until someone hand-compares.

returns/RETURN_FIELD_FOLD_2026-10-07.json — annotated, not rebased: added `counts_as_of` (numbers are its own historical snapshot), `live_counts_source` (returns/FIELD_FOLD_MAP.json), and `superseded_semantics` pointing here. Every original number preserved verbatim — history kept, misreading closed.

returns/FIELD_FOLD_MAP.json — regenerated by the fixed generator (schema field-fold/v2, added fields: unrecorded_count, fraying_count, residue kind/why, self_reference_files, verified_flagged, verified_flagged_independent, receipt_sync). No hand edits — generator output only.
after: The fold no longer asserts a single phase or flag the data does not establish. Live counts are generated into returns/FIELD_FOLD_MAP.json and cited by path here instead of restated, so this receipt cannot go stale the way its predecessor did — and map.receipt_sync now proves that property on every regeneration. Vocabulary remains converged (fraying residue 0 ≤ 9); the 49 silent returns are finally visible as UNDETERMINED missing data (RESIDUE kind `unrecorded`) instead of a false ⚊ SOURCE claim; verified-flagged dropped 97 → 72 purely by removing the 26 false ACTIVE positives (72 = 70 independent + the fold's own 2 receipts, which are now labelled self-reference and excluded from the independent count).
